messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm about to promote the staging overlay that wires inbound TLS + CORS for the new /api/v2 endpoint. Quick ask: can someone double-check the secrets path and the ingress annotations before I push the promote?

maria: PR is linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/578 — changes are in kustomize/overlays/staging/ingress.yaml and terraform/modules/ingress/values.tf

devon: looking now. main things to confirm: the cert ARN location and whether we should keep the `alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect` annotation (we moved other services to TLS at LB level).

ashwin: ping @devon — also note the CORS header is set via configmap patch, not the ingress rule. I left a comment in the PR about adding `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials`.

maria: certs are referenced from Secrets Manager at `secretsmanager:/redwood/staging/tls/ingress-cert`. Is that the same path the LB module reads?

devon: module reads `module.ingress.cert_secret_arn` which is wired from TF var `cert_secret_arn`. In the overlay promote I see we switched to a new param name `tls_secret_path` — that's why the CI plan shows drift. Need to add a small tfvar mapping in overlays/staging/terraform.tfvars.

maria: ah right — I changed the var name to be more explicit. I'll revert or add mapping. Which do you prefer? revert to `cert_secret_arn` or add `tls_secret_path = secretsmanager:/redwood/staging/tls/ingress-cert`?

devon: add mapping for now to avoid churn. We can follow up with a rename in a dedicated PR. Also please include the ARN lookup call we use elsewhere: `data "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "tls" { secret_id = var.tls_secret_path }` — then set `cert_secret_arn = data.aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.tls.secret_string` in the module input.

katie: small note on the k8s side: ingress class changed to `alb` last month. Make sure the overlay sets `kubernetes.io/ingress.class: alb`. Linter (kube-lint) will fail otherwise.

sre-bot: CI: terraform plan failed on staging overlay — missing var `tls_secret_path` in terraform.tfvars (module: ingress). See: https://ci.internal.redwood/run/7543

maria: thanks, fixing now. Also, for CORS: the configmap patch uses `cors.allowedOrigins: ["https://studio.redwood.ai"]` — should we include `https://console.redwood.ai` too?

ashwin: include both. The frontend team will need console access. Add `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true` to the nginx configmap patch. I left a snippet in the PR comment.

devon: quick config snippet for the ingress annotations (copy into ingress.yaml):

```
metadata:
  annotations:
    kubernetes.io/ingress.class: "alb"
    alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internet-facing
    alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/listen-ports: '[{"HTTP":80},{"HTTPS":443}]'
    alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/certificate-arn: "${var.cert_secret_arn}"
    alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: '443'
```

maria: thanks. One more gating question: for the staging promote, do we need a canary in staging (5% traffic) before full promote? Or is staging always full traffic by design here?

katie: staging is safe to be full traffic internally, but do a canary in prod when promoting. For release gating: add `overlay-promote: require-approval=eng-oncall` in the PR description so the release bot knows to pause before prod.

maria: good call. I'll add the label and update the runbook link in the PR (runbook: https://wiki.redwood/infrastructure/ingress-promote-runbook).

devon: also run `kubectl apply --dry-run=server -f overlays/staging/ingress.yaml` against our staging cluster after you patch the tfvars. That should catch any admission webhooks or missing fields.

maria: done. Dry-run passed locally. TF plan now shows no missing vars after I added `tls_secret_path` mapping. Pushed new commit.

ashwin: left an LGTM on the CORS/content changes.

katie: I'll do the rollout watch once CI passes and the staging cluster is updated — will open a canary monitor for 10 minutes.

maria: thanks everyone. Final checklist I'm doing before promote: update tfvars mapping, confirm cert lookup is used by module, set `ingress.class: alb`, update configmap with credentials header, add PR label `overlay-promote: require-approval=eng-oncall`, link runbook.

devon: tiny nit: include a rollback snippet in the PR description so anyone can revert the overlay quickly: `git revert <commit> && ./scripts/promote-overlay staging`.

maria: added rollback command. CI green now. tagging @eng-oncall for approval. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Deploy note: staging ingress apply triggered by pipeline 7543 at 2026-03-17T15:02:18Z. Monitor: https://monitoring.redwood/ingress/staging

katie: Approved. Going to observe the ingress health for 15m and then we'll schedule prod promote tomorrow during the maintenance window.

maria: awesome — thanks all. Closing this thread after prod promote prep in the morning.
